facts.business: Starbeam Ventures Limited (formerly Bluegod Entertainment Limited) is a listed company that provides unsecured loans to corporates and others, with financial assets constituting more than 50% of total assets and income from financial assets exceeding 50% of gross income, making NBFC registration provisions applicable though not obtained.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Company's financial assets constitute more than 50% of total assets and income from financial assets constitute more than 50% of gross income, making Section 45-IA of RBI Act applicable, but company has not obtained NBFC registration. Loans from individuals accepted but management claims these are business advances wrongly classified as deposits. BSE imposed fine of Rs. 1,71,100 for delay in submission of financial results for quarter and year ended March 31, 2026.

key_risks: NBFC registration requirement not met despite meeting asset/income criteria
Misclassification of business advances as loans/deposits
Regulatory non-compliance leading to BSE fines
Geopolitical tensions and trade policy uncertainty
Inflationary pressures affecting monetary policy and borrowing costs
facts.related_party_note: None of the transactions with related parties (related to business) falls under the scope of Section 188(1) of the Act. Information on transactions with related parties pursuant to section 134(3)(h) read with rule 8(2) of Companies (Accounts) Rules, 2014 are given in Annexure II in Form AOC-2.
